properties.name: The memory measurement holds what the answering agent may read to the same budget in every arm, so structure is compared, not capacity
properties.source: Anthony Sligar, 2026-10-29: "Go with your recommendation is (b), (c) and (d) next, and (a)" (option b of the open question on where structure starts to matter)
properties.statement: When the measurement compares reflow2 with plain notes, the agent that answers from memory may read the same number of tokens in every arm: notes are searched or read in part, reflow2 is queried. A difference then shows whether structure helps, not whether one arm had room to hold everything.
